participants: Andrew Jin / Andrew Musial (closer, Primal Instinct)
summary: Mid-week team meeting covering wins, a new deposit policy, an announcement that Harry Edmonds has left the team, projections and a call review with Ben. Andrew reports both of his calls from that morning - the Carlos Baston disqualification and the Jonn Nolitt close, which he describes as 'a flat earther' and a former Oracle C-level exec at 9.9% body fat. Chris introduces a hard deposit rule: no onboarding or follow-up call goes on a calendar without a deposit, extended to spouse objections and any money-logistics delay. He also discloses that marketing direction is changing to target the profile that has closed best, with ads temporarily down. Andrew reports that Manny, the prospect reviewed on 06/08, no-showed his follow-up and texted that he felt pushed and that his father's alcoholism had been used on him. The back half is a review of Ben's call with Ricardo, whose objection was that $6,000 would buy an in-person trainer, roleplayed twice.
notable: New deposit policy stated: 'moving forward, no onboarding calls go on the calendar unless we take a deposit', extended to spouse objections, any money-moving delay, and follow-up calls as a show-rate test.

Manager instructs reps to withhold the deposit amount deliberately to test the prospect's reaction - 'I actually like to not tell them what the deposit is going to be and then see if they react terribly to it.'
Manager states that once a card is on file the company can run it - 'once the card's on file, we can technically just run it.' Flagged separately.
Prospects are financially profiled before the call from third-party data - 'I looked up his financial data. He's got 10K credit. He's got 106K income.' Flagged separately.
Prospects are screened by country of origin for ability to pay, with harder financial qualification prescribed for named countries. Flagged separately.
Prospects interact with an AI chatbot in the funnel and reps read those messages - 'he messaged our AI bot', 'he actually texted also the, our AI chat bot'.
Harry Edmonds has left the team by mutual agreement. He is the rep whose 2026-06-09 call is the source of the stated ICP definition in data/icp.json, so the ICP's author is no longer in the business.
Ads were switched off during this period and lead flow is down, which changes the composition of the corpus mid-window.

Kim describes sending free resources to prospects who are disqualified on affordability, and reports a positive response weeks later. Chris frames it as the team value: 'Leave people better than when you found them.'
